market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Technical textiles overall: ~$206.14B (2024) to ~$272.33B by 2030, CAGR 4.8%. Geosynthetics alone: estimates diverge by source, ~$18-20B (2025) to ~$32.6-45.3B by 2035, CAGR 6.1-9.5% depending on methodology. Global aquaculture (end-market for nets): ~$334-359B (2025) to ~$418-425B by 2030, CAGR ~5-6%; the aquaculture cage-net sub-segment specifically is smaller and faster-growing, ~$2.3B by 2030 at 8.5% CAGR.
globalCompetitors: not cleanly identified — public 'peer group' screens (Raymond, Ginni Filaments, Garnet International, SVP Global Textiles) are generic textile companies, not true netting/geosynthetics comparables; flagged as a data-quality gap, not filled with a guess
market.domesticSlice: India geosynthetics market: ~$1.5-1.63B (2023-24) to ~$2.73B by 2030, CAGR ~9-10%, driven by National Infrastructure Pipeline (~$1.4T), PM Gati Shakti (~$1.2T), Bharatmala Pariyojana (34,000+ km highways), and rail projects requiring track-bed geosynthetic stabilization

structureFacts: India's infrastructure push (National Infrastructure Pipeline, PM Gati Shakti, Bharatmala, high-speed rail) structurally drives geosynthetics demand for soil/erosion control and track-bed stabilization

Ghost-gear/marine-plastic-pollution pressure is pushing biodegradable fishing-gear adoption in North America and Europe, though biodegradable nets currently remain less durable than conventional nets — a live substitution risk, not yet a displacement

adoptionStructure.note: No clean seed-replacement-style recurring-demand structure found for this segment; demand is project/contract-driven (infra) and operational-replacement-driven (aquaculture nets wear out and are replaced on a use-cycle, not a seasonal one)

drivers: regulatory compliance and sustainability credentials (biodegradability, ghost-gear reduction) — increasingly influential in Europe/North America aquaculture procurement
infrastructure-grade certification and soil/erosion-control performance specs for geosynthetics buyers (NHAI/PWD/railway contractors)
customerValue.strongestPredictor: not established by available research — durability and regulatory/infra-spec compliance both surfaced as gating factors, no single strongest predictor identified
